notes.title: Update v0.9.1.3
notes.content:
New update with several fixes:

Fixed crashes:

 Fixed crash on level 10
 Fixed crash save/load menu


Localization:

 The game now is fully available in spanish!
 Last scene in russian language was not available. Fixed.


General polish improvements:

 Now the robot explodes with damage, smoke and particles.
 Dragging the robot to the edge of the screen now scrolls.
 Save file now human readable.
 Rocket level now with star background.
 Minions now have KO particles/stars and sound
 Characters now have KO particles/stars and sound
 Guns now generate fire blast.
 Bullets now generate impact smoke.
 Moon buggy now emitting smoke.


Small fixed bugs:

 Level 6: When glass exploded turrets came back to life.
 Level 5 and 6: Garbage white projection is now longer to improve aiming.
